newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* Indonesia's state-owned Danareksa Fund Management said it had obtain approval from the capital market supervisoryy agency to sell its products through a multi-level marketing system.
* Two of Indonesia's largest listed firms, Indofood and Indocement, announced rises in their nine-month results.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 8.77 points, or 1.41 percent, to close at 611.50 points on Thursday following weak market sentiment which prompted profit-taking almost across the board.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be soft on Friday due to a lack of fresh leads while profit-taking in some big-caps was likely to continue.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,344.00/44.40 in early trading against the opening of 2,343.75/44.75.
* Indocement on posting a net profit of 389.46 billion rupiah against 322.10 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
* Conglomerate Bimantara on reports it was expected to win the tender to build a 584 billion rupiah toll road in East Java.
* H.M. Sampoerna on an announcement it had revised down its 1996 net profit forecast on lower-than-expected sales of its hand-made and machine-made cigarettes in the first nine
* Indofood on posting a net profit of 258.59 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 225.07 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
